question: When is someone truly liberated rather than only partially liberated?
premises: A person may be freed from one limitation.
That same person may still remain within another limitation.
Complete liberation requires freedom from all limitations.
inference: Therefore one who is freed only in part is still not fully liberated, while the truly liberated is free from all limitations.
plain_english: So someone may be liberated in one respect and still remain unliberated because another limitation persists. Only one who is free from all limitations is truly liberated.
